page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Below the last line, at the foot left, a gathering signature. No margin notes, no running head, no page number, no catchword.

main_text.l: tradere. Eft autè hic ille Theo-
carus. Nam quod ille integer ad
iore cura ac ftudio, ceu tabulæ
nè vereri unquâ fubiit, ne quas

page.notes: The signature "ā 4" at the foot is read with a doubtful macron over the a; it may be a plain "a 4". The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page. The line-end hyphens in "Theo-", "im-", "fu-", "colli-", "fa-", "ve-", "viro-" and "exci-" are printed and are kept.
